title: Investigation
description: Everything about one client (IP) and/or user in the time range. Set the variables, click a detection, or click a client in Security overview.

list.name: ip
list.label: Client IP (regex)
list.description: A client's address, e.g. 192.168.50.140. .* is everyone.

list.name: user
list.label: User (regex)
list.description: An Authelia/lldap username or a Vaultwarden email. .* is everyone.

list.name: filter
list.label: Events filter (LogsQL)
list.description: Which lines the Events panel shows, before the client and user. A detection's link sets it to its rule's filter. The default: every line with a client or user.

panels.title: Detections
panels.description: Alert instances in the time range whose rule extracted this client or user. Click a detection to investigate it: its client and user, from 10 minutes before it first fired (the rules count over 5 minutes) to a minute after it last fired, and the Events panel filtered to the lines its rule counts (before any threshold; its other labels, such as the namespace, aren't applied).

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Every pod log line and audit event the Events filter keeps (by default: with a client, source.ip or client.ip, or a user, user.name) for this client and user, whatever its source: the Gateway, Authelia, Vaultwarden, lldap, the Kubernetes API, Falco, the prx-999 hosts' journals, ... The source is in brackets (event.dataset).

panels.title: Requests by site and status
panels.description: This client's requests through the Gateway.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} source.ip:~"^${ip}$" | copy url.domain as host, http.response.status_code as response_code | stats by (host, response_code) count() as requests, uniq_values(url.original) limit 5 as examples, max(_time) as _time | replace_regexp ("^\\[\\]$|^\\[\"|\"\\]$", "") at examples | replace ("\",\"", ", ") at examples | replace ("\\\"", "\"") at examples | replace ("\\u0027", "'") at examples | replace ("\\u003c", "<") at examples | replace ("\\u003e", ">") at examples | replace ("\\u0026", "&") at examples | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: User agents
panels.description: The clients' user agents: a browser, curl, a scanner, an app.

targets.expr: _time:$__range {event.dataset="envoy.access"} source.ip:~"^${ip}$" | copy user_agent.original as user_agent | stats by (user_agent) count() as requests, max(_time) as _time | sort by (requests desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Gateway requests
panels.description: This client's requests, newest first (/static/ files left out).

panels.title: Authelia
panels.description: Authelia's lines for this client and user (failed logins, bans, unknown usernames).

panels.title: Vaultwarden
panels.description: Vaultwarden's failed logins for this client and user (it logs nothing for a success).

panels.title: lldap-bootstrap changes
panels.description: Reverted changes that mention this user.

panels.title: Audit log
panels.description: This client's and user's Kubernetes API requests (what the audit policy keeps).

panels.title: Vault
panels.description: Vault's audit log (responses) for this client and identity.

panels.title: Journals
panels.description: The VMs' journal lines mentioning this client and user (SSH, sudo, Forgejo).
